alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 6 at 9:33AM EDT until October 6 at 1:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Boston Harbor; Cape Cod Bay; Nantucket Sound; Vineyard Sound; Buzzards Bay; Rhode Island Sound; Narragansett Bay; Block Island Sound; Massachusetts Bay and Ipswich Bay
alerts.description: * WHAT...Northwest winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas around 3 feet. * WHERE...Portions of Massachusetts coastal waters and Rhode Island coastal waters. * WHEN...Until 1 PM EDT this afternoon. * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
alerts.instruction: Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

alerts.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 6 at 9:28AM EDT until October 7 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Hartford; Tolland; Windham; Northern Worcester; Central Middlesex County; Western Hampden; Eastern Hampden; Western Norfolk; Northern Bristol; Western Plymouth; Southern Bristol; Southern Plymouth; Northwest Middlesex County
alerts.description: * WHAT...Temperatures dropping to between 31 to 36 will result in frost formation. * WHERE...Portions of northern Connecticut and central, eastern, southeastern, and western Massachusetts. * WHEN...From 11 PM this evening to 9 AM EDT Wednesday. * IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
alerts.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.
